figurative_meaning_en: The beginning of decline; the onset of downfall
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পরিবারে ভাঙন ধরেছে, সবাই আলাদা হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Cracks are appearing in this family; everyone will separate soon.
Economic decline has begun in society.
history: This idiom reflects the cultural shift from joint family systems to nuclear families due to urbanization and modernization in Bengal during the 20th century.
note: Often used in contexts of social or familial disintegration.
